$comment: Per-project settings for the session protocol. EDIT THIS FILE, never the scripts in .claude/scripts/ — they are byte-identical across projects and checked against the template. Every key is optional; missing keys fall back to the defaults shown here. Keys starting with $ are comments.
$spine_heading: Case-insensitive text of the ROADMAP.md heading that opens the status spine table. The start hook injects everything from that heading to the next '## '.
$check_command: Shell command run at /end Step 0c BEFORE anything is committed (build freshness, contract drift, typecheck). Non-zero exit stops the wrap. Empty = skipped. Example: "pnpm check".
$audit_command: Shell command run at session start; mentioned only if it reports findings. Example: "pnpm audit --prod" or "cargo audit". Empty = skipped.
$push_policy: "ask" = never push without asking (default). "standing" = session-end pushes are pre-authorised so work can continue from another machine — record that authorisation in DECISIONS.md first. Force pushes always need per-instance confirmation regardless.
$protected_branches: Branches a session must never commit to, e.g. ["main"] in a fork where main is a read-only mirror of upstream. The start hook trips the branch guard on them exactly as it does for a worktree. Empty = only worktrees and claude/* branches are guarded.
$upstream_ref: A remote-tracking ref this branch is periodically brought up to date with, e.g. "upstream/main" in a fork. The start hook fetches that remote and reports how many commits the ref has that HEAD lacks — reported, never acted on at start (merge or rebase is a session decision at a quiet point, per the project's DECISIONS.md). The statusline shows `upstream +N`. Empty = off.
$secret_scan: Run .claude/scripts/scan-secrets.py at /end Step 0c. Content-based; .gitignore is only a blocklist.
$index_skip_prefixes: Project-relative path prefixes (POSIX) the codebase-index hook ignores, on top of the built-in ones (.claude/, node_modules/, dist/, build/, target/, .next/, __pycache__/). Put generated code here, e.g. "apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/".
$ledger: Size rules for docs/SESSION_LEDGER.md. item_max_chars is a HARD cap on one item's text (the start hook truncates over it); open_soft_max is a target count reported at /end; stale_after_days lists old open items at /end as route-or-close; prune_closed_after_days removes struck lines at /end (history lives in git).
$tracks: Parallel tracks — two sessions working on two VERSIONS of the app (e.g. desktop and mobile) in the same checkout on the same branch. Empty = single track (ledger IDs are L-N, no ownership rules). With 2+ tracks: each session declares its track at start, mints IDs with its own prefix (D-1, M-1 — independent counters, so no collisions), edits only its own 'owns' paths plus shared_paths, and the stop hook tolerates the OTHER track's uncommitted files only inside that track's owns. Optional "aliases": other words your existing docs use for the track ("android", "phone") — accepted in →tags and used to match legacy handoff lines. Example: [{"name": "desktop", "prefix": "D", "owns": ["apps/desktop/", "packages/frontend/"]}, {"name": "mobile", "prefix": "M", "owns": ["platforms/android/"], "aliases": ["android", "phone"]}]
$shared_paths: Paths every track may edit (shared packages, the server, docs). A change here must be announced with a ledger line tagged →all or →<other track> saying what changed and what the other side must do (rebuild, redeploy, run a migration). Example: ["packages/core/", "apps/server/"]
